THREE DIRECTIONS, ONE PRODUCT

Choose a direction. Or blend them.

Generate an employee experience example with the real catalogue and composer. Compare its sidebar, editorial and rail workspace structures, then edit the exact project in Workbench.

Generate example directionsCompose your own brief
THE COMPOSITION PARADIGM
Not a component library.
A composition system.

Traditional registries give you hundreds of disconnected buttons and tables, leaving you to manually reconcile spacing, typography, and contrast. Tessellate coordinates everything through a unified mathematical Design DNA.

Component Library Approach
Loose Parts: Isolated primitives with no awareness of the surrounding screen or product domain.
Styling Discordance: Radii clash, hover states conflict, and color chroma drifts across pages.
Manual Assembly: You write boilerplate glue code to stitch components into coherent layouts.
Blind AI Prompts: Code LLMs
